title: hub v3
script:
--// Kavo UI Library
local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()

local Window = Library.CreateLib("Kavo Hub - Brookhaven", "DarkTheme")

--// PLAYER TAB
local PlayerTab = Window:NewTab("Player")
local PlayerSection = PlayerTab:NewSection("Funções Player")

-- Speed
PlayerSection:NewSlider("Speed", "Velocidade do player", 200, 16, function(s)
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = s
end)

-- Jump
PlayerSection:NewSlider("Jump Power", "Altura do pulo", 200, 50, function(j)
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = j
end)

-- Reset Speed
PlayerSection:NewButton("Reset Speed", "Volta ao normal", function()
    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
end)

--// TELEPORT TAB
local TeleportTab = Window:NewTab("Teleport")
local TpSection = TeleportTab:NewSection("Locais")

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer

-- Teleport para Banco
TpSection:NewButton("Banco", "Ir para o banco", function()
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0) -- mude coords
end)

-- Teleport para Hospital
TpSection:NewButton("Hospital", "Ir para hospital", function()
    player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(100, 0, 100)
end)

--// FUN TAB
local FunTab = Window:NewTab("Fun")
local FunSection = FunTab:NewSection("Diversão")

-- Spin
FunSection:NewButton("Spin", "Girar infinito", function()
    while true do
        wait()
        player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame *= CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(10), 0)
    end
end)

-- Float
FunSection:NewButton("Float", "Flutuar", function()
    local body = Instance.new("BodyForce")
    body.Force = Vector3.new(0, workspace.Gravity * player.Character.HumanoidRootPart:GetMass(), 0)
    body.Parent = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
end)

--// CREDITOS
local CreditsTab = Window:NewTab("Créditos")
local CreditSection = CreditsTab:NewSection("Info")

CreditSection:NewLabel("Criado por você + ChatGPT 😎")
